steps.title: Culture neuroblastoma cell lines
steps.instruction: Thaw SK‑N‑BE(2) and SH‑SY5Y cells (ATCC) and culture in DMEM medium containing 10 % fetal bovine serum (Corning) at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ (Thermo Fisher Scientific). Use cells within 6 months after resuscitation.

steps.title: Treat cells with BPTF inhibitor
steps.instruction: Add BPTF inhibitor AU1 (GlpBio) to the culture medium at the desired concentration between 20 µM and 40 µM.

steps.title: Infect cells with shRNA lentivirus
steps.instruction: Add GFP‑tagged lentiviral shRNA (shNC, shBPTF‑1, shBPTF‑2; sequences: shNC 5’-TTCTCCGAACGTGTCACGT‑3’, shBPTF‑1 5’-CAGGAGAGTTCTCAAGTAG‑3’, shBPTF‑2 5’-GGTGGCAATCAAGGTTTGA‑3’) produced by Shanghai Genepharma to the cells. Incubate and harvest cells 96 h after infection for downstream experiments.

steps.title: Transfect cells with siRNA
steps.instruction: When cells in a 6‑well plate reach 30–50 % confluence, transfect with siRNA (siNC, siTFAP4‑1, siTFAP4‑2; sequences: siNC 5’-GGCUCUAGAAAAGCCUAUGC‑3’, siTFAP4‑1 5’-TGGGATTGTCAGCCTTCAA‑3’, siTFAP4‑2 5’-GGACAAGGACGAAGGCATA‑3’) using Lipofectamine RNAiMax (Thermo Fisher Scientific). After 72 h, collect cells for subsequent experiments.

steps.title: Extract total protein
steps.instruction: Lyse harvested cells in RIPA lysis buffer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) containing a protease inhibitor cocktail and a phosphatase inhibitor cocktail (Roche, Germany). Measure protein concentration with the Pierce BCA Protein Assay Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Separate proteins by SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Load 15–20 µg protein per lane onto either a 4–12 % precast gel (cat. HLG2001‑412 T, Shanghai Haling Biotechnology) or a 10 % SDS‑PAGE gel and run electrophoresis.

steps.title: Transfer proteins to membrane
steps.instruction: Transfer the resolved proteins onto a 0.45 µm PVDF membrane (Millipore, Germany).

steps.title: Perform immunoblotting
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane overnight at 4 °C with primary antibodies at the indicated dilutions: anti‑BPTF (ab72036, 1:2000), anti‑N‑cadherin (ab76057, 1:1000) (Abcam); anti‑TFAP4 (Sc‑377042, 1:1000), anti‑E‑cadherin (sc‑8426, 1:1000) (Santa Cruz); anti‑AKT (CST‑4691t, 1:1000), anti‑pAKT (CST‑13038S, 1:1000), anti‑GAPDH (CST‑5174S, 1:1000) (Cell Signaling Technology); anti‑HA (H9658, 1:20 000) (Sigma). Then incubate for ~1 h at room temperature with HRP‑conjugated anti‑rabbit/mouse secondary antibody (Proteintech) diluted 1:3000. Visualize bands using enhanced chemiluminescence reagents (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

steps.title: Set up proliferation assay
steps.instruction: In an E‑Plate 16, add 50 µl medium to each well and verify that the Cell Index is below 0.063. Then add 100 µl cell suspension containing 4 × 10³ cells per well. Monitor the Cell Index every 15 min for at least 96 h.

steps.title: Set up migration assay
steps.instruction: Add 165 µl DMEM with 10 % FBS to the lower chamber of a CIM‑Plate and 30 µl serum‑free DMEM to the upper chamber. Balance the plate in a 37 °C incubator for 1 h. Then add 100 µl serum‑free DMEM containing 4 × 10⁴ cells to each upper chamber. After a 30 min incubation at 37 °C, start real‑time monitoring, measuring Cell Index every 15 min for at least 48 h. Use four replicate wells per group.
